task.instruction: Find out how much more package storage the Enterprise version has over Team in GitHub Pricing.

final_answer: Enterprise includes 48GB more GitHub Packages storage than Team. Enterprise gets 50GB and Team gets 2GB, so Enterprise has 25 times as much. For comparison, the Free plan gets 500MB.

judge.rationale: The pricing page text shows Team has 2GB of Packages storage and Enterprise has 50GB, supporting the agent’s 48GB difference.
